description: This Swift file defines a singleton class `TerminationSignalWatcher` that monitors system termination signals (`SIGTERM` and `SIGINT`) to facilitate graceful shutdown of the application. It sets up signal handlers, logs their receipt, and triggers cleanup procedures such as stopping pairing prompts and terminating the app process.

classes.name: TerminationSignalWatcher
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for monitoring system termination signals and orchestrating a graceful application shutdown.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes signal handlers for SIGTERM and SIGINT to start monitoring for termination requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Removes all signal handlers and resets internal state related to termination monitoring.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up a signal source for a given signal number and defines the event handler that manages the shutdown process.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Executes the shutdown procedure upon receiving a termination signal, including stopping pairing prompts and terminating the app.
